item.title: Ep 2: European Union goods trade with Southeast Asia reached two hundred seventy five billion…
item.description: Omni View Asia Pacific European Union goods trade with Southeast Asia reached two hundred seventy five billion euros last year, strengthening supply chains for six ASEAN countries.
